senses.gloss: --a tribe, on the other side of the Vindhyas. M. ११४. ५३; वा. ४५. १३३.
--a son of Tumba; had two sons. Br. III. ७१. २५८.
--a निषाद tribe; on the other side of the Vindhyas. वा. ६२. १२४; ४५. १३३.

(I)--an expert in divine music; had two daughters मनोवती and सुकेशा;
1: वा. ६९. ४७, ४९.
a friend of Candrodaka दुन्दुभी.
2: Ib. ९६. ११७.
A Gandharva disciple of नारद, came with the sage to see युधिष्ठिर, and returned to heaven with him;
3: भा. I. १३. ३७ and ५९.
sang with नारद the glories of Ananta;
4: Ib. V. २५. 8.
praised हिरण्यकशिपु when he became the overlord of all worlds.
5: Ib. VII. 4. १४.
Sang the praise of कृष्ण when he held the Govardhana;
6: Ib. X. २५. ३२; २७. २४.
presiding over the months of Madhu and माधव.
7: Ib. XII. ११. ३३; Br. II. २३. 4.
His two daughters were celebrated as पञ्चचूडस्;
8: Ib. III. 7. 9; IV. २०. ५० and १०१.
residing in the Sun's chariot in the months of Caitra and Madhu.
9: वा. ५२. 3; ३६. ४७; Vi. II. १०. 3.
(II)--a friend of Anu, son of Kapotaroma. भा. IX. २४. २०.
